intro: Hi! In this lesson you learn there is and there are, the English way to say 'ada'. You'll describe a room or a place, ask what is there (Is there an ATM near here?) and use some and any. Warm-up: what is in your room right now?
teachingNotes: Indonesian 'ada' becomes there is / there are. The biggest error is using have for 'ada': *'In my room have a bed'* → **There is a bed in my room.** Pattern: there is/are + thing + place. 'My room has a bed' is also correct English, but practise there is/are here.

is or are depends on the noun after it: one thing (a/an) → there is (short: there's); two or more → there are. Common error: *'There is two chairs'* → There are two chairs. Don't teach a short form for there are ('there're'). If the learner asks about lists, the first noun usually decides (There is a bed and two chairs), but don't drill it.
Negatives: there isn't a … (one thing), there aren't any … (two or more). Accept 'there is no / there are no' as correct, but teach isn't / aren't first.

Questions: put is/are first: Is there a …? Are there any …? Short answers use there: Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. Yes, there are. / No, there aren't. Common errors: *'Yes, it is'*, *'Yes, have'*, *'Is there two toilets?'*.

some/any only with plural countable nouns here: some in positive sentences (There are some shops), any in negatives and questions. Common error: *'Are there some shops near here?'* → Are there any shops near here? Don't use some/any with one thing (There is a chair, not 'some chair').

Limits: only the present. Don't teach there was/were, there will be, uncountable nouns with some/any, How much / How many (next lesson: a1-countable-some-any) or place prepositions like next to, under, behind, between (lesson a1-prepositions). Keep places to 'in …' and 'near …' (near here, near the station).

keyPoints.title: There is / there are = ada
keyPoints.explanation: Use there is (there's) for one thing and there are for two or more, then say the place: There is a bed in my room. Negatives: there isn't a …, there aren't any …. Don't use have for 'ada'.

examples.en: There is a bed in my room.
There are two bathrooms in our house.
examples.id: Ada dua kamar mandi di rumah kami.

examples.en: There isn't a TV in my bedroom.
examples.id: Tidak ada TV di kamar tidurku.

keyPoints.title: Is there …? / Are there …?
keyPoints.explanation: Put is or are first: Is there a …? (one thing), Are there …? (two or more). Short answers use there: Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.

examples.en: Is there an ATM near here? — Yes, there is.
examples.id: Ada ATM di dekat sini? — Ya, ada.

examples.en: Is there a fridge in the room? — No, there isn't.
examples.id: Ada kulkas di kamarnya? — Tidak ada.

examples.en: Are there two beds in the room? — Yes, there are.
examples.id: Ada dua tempat tidur di kamarnya? — Ya, ada.

keyPoints.title: some and any
keyPoints.explanation: With two or more things, use some in positive sentences (= beberapa) and any in negatives and questions: There are some shops. There aren't any shops. Are there any shops near here?

examples.en: There are some nice beaches in Lombok.
examples.id: Ada beberapa pantai yang bagus di Lombok.

examples.en: There aren't any shops in my village.
examples.id: Tidak ada toko sama sekali di desaku.

examples.en: Are there any shops near here?

guidedPractice.prompt: Complete with is or are: There ___ a big mirror in the bathroom.
Say it in English: Ada tiga kamar tidur di rumah Budi.
expected: there are three bedrooms in budi's house
in budi's house there are three bedrooms
guidedPractice.hint: Three bedrooms = two or more. Start with There …

guidedPractice.prompt: Make a question: There is a bank near here.
expected: is there a bank near here

guidedPractice.prompt: Complete with some or any: Are there ___ eggs in the fridge?

independentPractice.prompt: Correct the sentence: There is four people in my family.
expected: there are four people in my family

independentPractice.prompt: Answer yes with a short answer: Are there two bathrooms in your house?
Make it negative: There are some taxis outside.
expected: there are not any taxis outside
independentPractice.hint: In a negative, some becomes any.

assessment.prompt: Complete with is or are: There ___ three windows in Rina's kitchen.
acceptableAnswers: are
there are
there are three windows in rina's kitchen

assessment.prompt: Correct the sentence: In my office have a big printer.
acceptableAnswers: there is a big printer in my office
there's a big printer in my office
in my office there is a big printer
in my office there's a big printer
assessment.rubric: Correct: There is / There's a big printer in my office. 'My office has a big printer' = 70 (correct English, but not there is). 'There are a big printer' = 40. Keeping 'have' = 0.

assessment.prompt: Make it negative: There is a lift in this building.
acceptableAnswers: there isn't a lift in this building
there is not a lift in this building
there's not a lift in this building
there is no lift in this building
there's no lift in this building
assessment.rubric: Correct: There isn't a lift in this building (also There's no lift …). 'There aren't a lift' = 40. 'There don't have a lift' = 0.

assessment.prompt: You are at a hotel in Yogyakarta. Ask the receptionist if the hotel has a restaurant. Start with Is there …
acceptableAnswers: is there a restaurant in the hotel
is there a restaurant in this hotel
is there a restaurant in your hotel
is there a restaurant here
is there a restaurant
excuse me is there a restaurant in the hotel
excuse me is there a restaurant in this hotel
excuse me is there a restaurant here
excuse me is there a restaurant
assessment.rubric: Correct: Is there a restaurant (in the hotel / here)? 'Is there restaurant' (no a) = 70. 'Are there a restaurant' = 40. 'There is a restaurant?' = 30 (statement order). 'Have a restaurant?' = 0.

assessment.prompt: Listen to the question. The answer is no. Write the short answer.
assessment.listen: Is there a bus stop near your house?
acceptableAnswers: no there isn't
no there is not
no there's not
assessment.rubric: Correct: No, there isn't. 'No, there aren't' = 40 (the question is about one bus stop). 'No, it isn't' = 30. 'No' alone = 30. 'No, I don't have' = 0.

assessment.prompt: Complete with some or any: There aren't ___ chairs in the classroom.
acceptableAnswers: any
there aren't any chairs in the classroom
there are not any chairs in the classroom

assessment.prompt: Complete with some or any: There are ___ good cafés in Bandung.
acceptableAnswers: some
there are some good cafés in bandung
there are some good cafes in bandung

blocks.text: Indonesian says *ada* when something is in a place. English says **there is** for **one** thing and **there are** for **two or more**. Then say the place: **There is a bed in my room.** **There are two windows in the kitchen.** In speaking, *there is* is often **there's**. *There are* has no short form in writing.

id.text: Bahasa Indonesia memakai *ada* untuk sesuatu yang ada di suatu tempat. Bahasa Inggris memakai **there is** untuk **satu** benda dan **there are** untuk **dua atau lebih**. Lalu sebutkan tempatnya: **There is a bed in my room.** **There are two windows in the kitchen.** Saat bicara, *there is* sering disingkat **there's**. *There are* tidak punya bentuk pendek dalam tulisan.

rows.en: There is a bed in my room.
There's a big TV in the living room.
rows.id: Ada TV besar di ruang tamu.

rows.en: There are two bathrooms in our house.
rows.id: Ada dua kamar mandi di rumah kami.

rows.en: There are 30 students in my class.

blocks.text: Don't use **have** for *ada*: 'In my room have a bed' is wrong. Say **There is a bed in my room.** And look at the noun: 'There is two chairs' is wrong, because two chairs = **are**: **There are two chairs.**

id.text: Jangan pakai **have** untuk *ada*: 'In my room have a bed' salah. Katakan **There is a bed in my room.** Dan lihat kata bendanya: 'There is two chairs' salah, karena two chairs = **are**: **There are two chairs.**

blocks.prompt: Your hotel room in Bali is big. Complete: There ___ two beds in the room.
blocks.explain: Two beds = two or more, so there are. 'Have' is not used for 'ada'.

id.explain: Two beds = dua atau lebih, jadi there are. 'Have' tidak dipakai untuk 'ada'.

blocks.text: For *tidak ada*, add **not**: **there isn't a** + one thing, **there aren't any** + two or more. Long forms: *there is not*, *there are not*. (More about **any** in the last part.)

id.text: Untuk *tidak ada*, tambahkan **not**: **there isn't a** + satu benda, **there aren't any** + dua atau lebih. Bentuk panjangnya: *there is not*, *there are not*. (Penjelasan tentang **any** ada di bagian terakhir.)

rows.en: There isn't a TV in my bedroom.
rows.id: Tidak ada TV di kamar tidurku.

rows.en: There isn't an ATM in my village.
There aren't any shops in my village.
rows.id: Tidak ada toko sama sekali di desaku.

blocks.prompt: Rina's kos room has no TV. Complete: There ___ a TV in her room.
blocks.explain: A TV = one thing, so there isn't. 'Don't have' is the have mistake again.

id.explain: A TV = satu benda, jadi there isn't. 'Don't have' adalah kesalahan have tadi.

blocks.text: To ask, put **is** or **are** first: **Is there a …?** for one thing, **Are there …?** for two or more. The short answer uses **there**: **Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.** **Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.** Very useful when you travel!

id.text: Untuk bertanya, taruh **is** atau **are** di depan: **Is there a …?** untuk satu benda, **Are there …?** untuk dua atau lebih. Jawaban singkatnya memakai **there**: **Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.** **Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.** Sangat berguna saat kamu bepergian!

rows.en: Is there an ATM near here? — Yes, there is.
rows.id: Ada ATM di dekat sini? — Ya, ada.

rows.en: Is there a fridge in the room? — No, there isn't.
rows.id: Ada kulkas di kamarnya? — Tidak ada.

rows.en: Are there two beds in the room? — Yes, there are.
rows.id: Ada dua tempat tidur di kamarnya? — Ya, ada.

blocks.text: Answer with **there**, not *it* or *have*: **Yes, there is**, not 'Yes, it is' or 'Yes, have'. And match the noun: 'Is there two toilets?' is wrong; say **Are there two toilets?**

id.text: Jawab dengan **there**, bukan *it* atau *have*: **Yes, there is**, bukan 'Yes, it is' atau 'Yes, have'. Dan sesuaikan dengan kata bendanya: 'Is there two toilets?' salah; katakan **Are there two toilets?**

blocks.prompt: You need medicine. Which question is correct?
options: Is there a pharmacy near here?
Are there a pharmacy near here?
blocks.explain: A pharmacy = one thing, so Is there …? Don't use have for 'ada'.

id.explain: A pharmacy = satu benda, jadi Is there …? Jangan pakai have untuk 'ada'.

blocks.text: With two or more things, use **some** in positive sentences (= *beberapa*): **There are some shops near the hotel.** Use **any** in negatives and questions: **There aren't any shops.** **Are there any shops near here?** With one thing, use **a/an**: *There is a shop*, not 'there is some shop'.

id.text: Untuk dua benda atau lebih, pakai **some** dalam kalimat positif (= *beberapa*): **There are some shops near the hotel.** Pakai **any** dalam kalimat negatif dan pertanyaan: **There aren't any shops.** **Are there any shops near here?** Untuk satu benda, pakai **a/an**: *There is a shop*, bukan 'there is some shop'.

rows.en: There are some nice beaches in Lombok.
rows.id: Ada beberapa pantai yang bagus di Lombok.

rows.en: There aren't any trains to Bali.
Are there any good warungs near here?
rows.id: Ada warung yang enak di dekat sini?

blocks.text: A very common mistake: 'Are there some shops near here?' In questions, use **any**: **Are there any shops near here?**

id.text: Kesalahan yang sangat umum: 'Are there some shops near here?' Dalam pertanyaan, pakai **any**: **Are there any shops near here?**

blocks.prompt: Complete: There are ___ students in the library.
blocks.explain: It's a positive sentence with a plural noun, so some. Any is for negatives and questions, and a is only for one thing.

id.explain: Ini kalimat positif dengan kata benda jamak, jadi some. Any untuk kalimat negatif dan pertanyaan, dan a hanya untuk satu benda.

suggestedQuestions: Why can't I say 'In my room have a bed'?
Is 'My room has a bed' also correct?
What's the difference between some and any?
Can I write 'there're' for there are?

id.intro: Hai! Di pelajaran ini kamu belajar there is dan there are, cara bahasa Inggris mengatakan 'ada'. Kamu akan mendeskripsikan ruangan atau tempat, menanyakan apa yang ada di sana (Is there an ATM near here?) dan memakai some dan any. Pemanasan: apa saja yang ada di kamarmu sekarang?

Apakah 'My room has a bed' juga benar?
